categories.main_business_segments: Shaanxi Sirui Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of high-strength and high-conductivity copper alloy materials and products, medium and high-voltage electrical contact materials and products, high-performance metal chromium powder, medical imaging CT and DR tube components, optical module chip bases/housings, and liquid rocket engine thrust chamber inner walls. These segments serve industries such as rail transit, aerospace, power electronics, medical imaging, and artificial intelligence.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies including vacuum induction melting, vacuum self-consuming arc melting, vacuum sintering, vacuum infiltration, 3D printing, atmospheric protection continuous casting, vacuum atomization, vacuum electromagnetic levitation melting, and hot isostatic pressing. It also employs precision machining, vacuum brazing, surface treatment, and additive manufacturing techniques. Core proprietary technologies include copper-chromium alloy design, vacuum melting and casting methods, low-temperature liquid nitrogen grinding for chromium powder, and 3D printing for copper-chromium electrical contacts.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global industry leaders such as GE Group, Wabtec Group, Siemens Group, Alstom Group, CRRC Corporation, Schneider Electric, ABB, Eaton, and domestic medical imaging companies like United Imaging Healthcare. The company serves markets in rail transit, aerospace, power equipment, medical imaging, semiconductor equipment, and optical communications, with a strong focus on international markets and export sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Xi'an, Shaanxi Province, and has subsidiaries in various Chinese cities and a manufacturing presence in Thailand. It serves global markets with significant export sales to Europe, the Americas, and other regions, actively expanding its international footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shaanxi Sirui Advanced Materials operates mainly in the upstream and midstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of advanced copper alloy materials and components. It supplies critical materials and precision components to downstream manufacturers in rail transit, aerospace, power electronics, medical imaging, and optical communications industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes market-driven innovation, targeting leadership in multiple niche new material segments globally. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on high-strength, high-conductivity copper alloys, medium and high-voltage electrical contact materials, high-purity chromium powders, medical imaging components, optical module materials, and aerospace-grade copper alloys for rocket engines. It pursues advanced manufacturing technologies such as 3D printing, additive manufacturing, and digital R&D management platforms, and collaborates extensively with universities and research institutes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of advanced copper alloy materials, electrical contact products, metal powders, medical imaging components, and aerospace materials. The company operates a direct sales model, providing customized, non-standardized products tailored to customer specifications, with income recognized upon delivery and acceptance or export clearance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position domestically and internationally in high-strength high-conductivity copper alloys and medium-high voltage electrical contact materials, with market share exceeding 60% in some segments. It competes with global giants like GE, Siemens, ABB, and others, maintaining competitive advantages through proprietary technologies, extensive patent portfolios, and close collaboration with top-tier customers. It is recognized as a national champion and industry leader in several product categories.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.18 billion, representing an 18.71% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 98.34 million, a 26.04% increase. The company’s R&D investment reached RMB 59.45 million, accounting for 5.04% of revenue. Cash flow from operating activities increased significantly by 227.56%, reflecting strong business growth and improved receivables management. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.72 billion, with steady growth in net assets and profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shaanxi Sirui Advanced Materials differentiates itself through its advanced proprietary technologies, high-quality and high-performance copper alloy materials, and customized precision components that meet stringent requirements in high-end applications such as aerospace, rail transit, power electronics, and medical imaging. The company emphasizes innovation leadership, product reliability, and the ability to replace imports in critical material segments. Its integrated capabilities from material design to precision manufacturing and digital R&D management provide customers with comprehensive, high-value solutions.
